mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (receiver_type, receiver_id, sender_type, sender_id, message_type, content, related_id, is_read, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_type = #{receiverType} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
